metadata.case_name: LAM PIK KUEN v. LEE FAI MING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fractured left superior and inferior pubic rami
source: the plaintiff alleges that both pubic rami bones on the left side of her pelvis were broken as the result of the accident
Following the accident, the plaintiff was taken to Tang Shiu Kin Hospital where she was examined and found, following X-ray, to have suffered a fractured left superior and inferior pubic rami.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: irregularity / displacement of the pubic symphasis (cartilaginous or fibrous union of the frontal pelvic girdle)
source: He did find, however, that her pubic symphasis, a cartilaginous or fibrous union of the frontal pelvic girdle was irregular.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic rupture of symphysis pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to pelvic area resulting in residual/permanent pain
source: the plaintiff alleges ... together with soft tissue injury and that she has suffered permanent impairment.
In his view, the residual pain felt by the plaintiff emanated from soft tissue injury and that injury was permanent.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of pelvis

manifestations.description: left groin pain and tenderness on palpation of the left pubic rami area
tenderness when the sacroiliac joint of her pelvis was palpated (no sacroiliac joint injury on X-ray)
residual pain which will continue in future
unable to stand continuously for more than three to four hours at a time without 10-15 minutes rest
unfit for heavy work; fit for light to moderate work; less able to carry heavy objects
ability to squat down fully and walk with a normal gait (as found on examination)
plaintiff's complaint of difficulty in squatting and changing posture (disputed by examining doctors)
plaintiff's complaint of pain when menstruating and when having sex (reported by plaintiff)

treatments_received: treatment at Tang Shiu Kin Hospital (examination and X-ray)
follow-up orthopaedic treatment at Tang Chi Ngong Clinic

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (award of $150,000 for pain suffering and loss of amenities).
Less able to walk and stand; requires rest periods during the working day; unfit for heavy work; less able to carry heavy objects.
Real risk of losing her job and being at a disadvantage in finding other employment because of need for rest periods and inability to lift heavy loads (award of $40,000 for loss of earning capacity).
